context: M18 o10. (Nick.) Back in the vault, 3 a.m. Yiannis holds a clipboard. The ice is melting.

lines.speaker: char.yiannis_doukas
lines.text: You want the true count, Niko? Four hundred and twelve. Not nine hundred. Never nine.

lines.speaker: char.yiannis_doukas
lines.text: Pledged twice. Bank and lawyer. Now half are 'spoiled.' You're finished either way.

lines.speaker: char.yiannis_doukas
lines.text: Count is what you want it to be, boss. I didn't see anything.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: A skin tells you where it was cut. So does a man. I know, Yiannis.

lines.speaker: char.eleni_varelas
lines.text: Summer is when furriers go broke politely. We're not being polite anymore.
